# Cyborg Repair
Cyborgs and exosuits are tough, but they can still be damaged. Different tools are required to repair different types of damage.
## Repair Methods
-
**Welding Tool**: repairs Brute damage (-15), but causes **2** Deterioration damage per application.
-
**Wires**: repair Burn damage (-6) and **1** Deterioration.
-
**Nanopaste**: repairs **10** (all types) including Deterioration.
-
**Steel Sheets**: repair **5** Brute and **5** Deterioration damage per sheet.
## Deterioration
**Deterioration** is a special damage type representing severe structural integrity failure.
It is typically caused by: - Excessive welding repairs - Intense structural stress
As Deterioration increases, the chassis becomes deformed. Prioritize using **Steel**, **Wires**, or **Nanopaste** to fix this damage.
